events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV, the music television channel, launched on this day in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being its inaugural broadcast.

angles.name: MTV's Impact
angles.copy: Remember when music videos changed everything? Today marks the anniversary of MTV's launch, kicking off with The Buggles. What was the first music video that blew your mind?

events.title: Oasis released Definitely Maybe
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-two years ago, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your favourite track from this Britpop masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, opened on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. Which legendary performance do you wish you'd seen live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: King of Rock & Roll
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the King. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to shake, rattle, and roll generations. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Iconic guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, leaving an indelible mark on music.

angles.name: Jimi's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us too soon on this day. His guitar work still sounds like the future.

events.title: The Beatles released Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on this day in 1969 (UK release was Sept 26, US on Oct 1).

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure magic. What's your favourite from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and a distinctive voice in British rock, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple introduced its revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the first iPod, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'. How many did you own?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007's big screen debut. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Music legend John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy icon, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, always brilliant.

events.title: The Beatles released 'The White Album'
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What's your favourite deep cut from it?
